_comment: RaceRoom engine layouts, keyed by the sim's numeric VehicleInfo.ModelId. SimHub reports RaceRoom carIds as "<modelId>,<car name>", so the key is the part before the comma. Unlike iRacing, RaceRoom publishes NO cylinder count: its shared memory carries EngineType (combustion / electric / hybrid) and nothing else about the engine, so both the count and the crank have to come from here. This is a SEED: community CarFacts overrides any entry. Confidence low marks RaceRoom's fictional cars, whose engines are published nowhere.
_source: Car list from Sector3's own r3e-data.json (the spectator-overlay data file); engine specs from manufacturer and series data.
